product_family: MateCat is a free, open-source web-based Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tool designed for professional translators and Language Service Providers. The hosted version (matecat.com) is operated by Translated srl. MateCat features AI-driven precision, adaptive machine translation (ModernMT), and collaborative translation memory.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 & 2013
certifications.proof_quote: The Translated Trust Center lists "ISO/IEC 27001:2022" and "ISO/IEC 27001:2013" among its certifications. These are held by Translated srl, which operates the hosted matecat.com service; MateCat's own site does not reference them.

certifications.name: ISO 9001:2015
certifications.proof_quote: The Translated Trust Center lists "ISO 9001:2015" among its certifications. Held by Translated srl, the operator of the hosted matecat.com service.

certifications.name: ISO 17100:2015
certifications.proof_quote: The Translated Trust Center lists "ISO 17100:2015" (translation services) among its certifications. Held by Translated srl, the operator of the hosted matecat.com service.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: The Translated Trust Center lists "SOC 2 Type 1" among its attestations. Held by Translated srl, the operator of the hosted matecat.com service; note this is Type 1 (point-in-time), not Type 2.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: The Translated Trust Center lists "GDPR" among its compliance standards. MateCat's own terms state: 'We will not share, sell or transfer "Personal Data" to third parties without users' express consent' and commit to 'retaining your personal information only for as long as necessary.'

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: The Translated Trust Center lists "PCI DSS" among its compliance standards. Held by Translated srl, the operator of the hosted matecat.com service.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification for MateCat or Translated. As a translation tool, not positioned for healthcare/medical data handling.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification. MateCat does not market federal compliance certifications.

privacy.ai_training_note: MateCat uses AI/LLMs for context-specific terminology definitions and adaptive machine translation (ModernMT). No explicit opt-out policy documented for AI training on user translations. Public data segments contributed to MyMemory may be used for model improvement; private segments are marked and protected.
privacy.data_region: Not explicitly stated; inferred EU (Translated srl based in Italy, uses AWS infrastructure with EU data centers)

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: MateCat privacy guide states it 'works with an encryption layer which uses the SSL protocol for server-to-client communication' and that 'all data sent from your browser to the Matecat servers is encrypted and cannot be read by third parties'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Data stored in secure cloud storage with advanced encryption and built-in redundancy across multiple locations

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: AWS-based infrastructure (Translated operates the hosted service); Translated maintains firewall, IDS/IPS, and network penetration testing

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Automated account management, access logging, controlled data access protocols; private vs. public data classification

security.name: Data availability
security.value: Built-in redundancy ensures data is backed up in multiple locations; users can download data at any time for migration

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Translated maintains incident response procedures with designated personnel per its Trust Center documentation

security.name: Endpoint protection
security.value: Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), disk encryption, anti-malware solutions (via Translated infrastructure)

products.name: MateCat (Hosted)
products.data_scope: Translation projects, segments, translation memories, termbases, user authentication data, usage analytics
products.notes: Free, web-based, unlimited users and projects. No per-seat pricing. Includes adaptive MT (ModernMT), AI-powered terminology suggestions, and real-time collaboration. Public and private data modes supported.

products.name: MateCat (Open Source / Self-Hosted)
products.data_scope: Same as hosted version, but fully under user's control when self-hosted
products.notes: LGPL-licensed, open-source. Users can download source code and deploy on their own infrastructure for complete data sovereignty. No SaaS trust/compliance inheritance in this mode.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free hosted translation tool; revenue from outsourced translation services marketplace)
compare.data_residency: Hosted version: EU (Translated based in Italy; uses AWS); Self-hosted: user-controlled

flags: MateCat does not explicitly market or reference Translated's certifications in its own security/compliance documentation. Certs belong to parent company Translated srl; certification applicability to MateCat product itself could be clearer.
No explicit privacy policy found at standard location (privacy.matecat.com returned 404); privacy terms embedded in site.matecat.com/terms.

AI training data practices unclear: MateCat uses LLMs for terminology and adaptive MT but no explicit opt-out mechanism documented. Public data contributed to MyMemory may be used for model improvement.
Data center location not explicitly disclosed; inferred EU based on Translated's Italy headquarters and AWS mention, but specific region(s) not stated.
MateCat is free, open-source tool operated by a growth-stage company (Translated), but certifications belong to the service operator (Translated srl), not the product brand (MateCat).
